theme: Mid-charter Sunday — the water has the day.
greeting: One 15-minute sync this morning, then nothing on the calendar, Dan. You're mid-charter on the Adriatic and the girls are with Jen, so the day is genuinely yours — the one thing worth catching from dry land is the Cavtat wrap-up before connectivity thins out.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat landing before the boat cuts off
needsAttention.detail: Three things still need arranging from shore before you disembark Sat Sept 19: the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and a ~5:15 AM express checkout for the Sept 20 flight. The hotel's free-cancellation window also closes Sept 15, so it locks in from the boat.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car outright
needsAttention.detail: In your travel board, marked p1 and overdue since Sept 9 - no longer a hedge. Full-size SUV out of TPA for the whole span; you land Sept 20 at 3:55 PM on a Sunday, so don't arrive without it booked.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike

flagged.title: Fidium payment confirmed

The day stays open and the girls are with Jen this stretch, so the night is unclaimed.
